correctness.rationale: Let K=F_{q^d}, d=gcd(k,m). The q^k and q^{m-k} Frobenius maps fix K. Therefore both phi=lambda Id+mu F^k and its trace adjoint phi†=lambda Id+mu^{q^{m-k}}F^{m-k} are K-linear. The trace pairing is nondegenerate for all prime powers, including characteristic dividing m; hence Hull(im phi)=im phi cap ker phi†. If lambda or mu=0 the adjoint is bijective. Otherwise any nonzero u,v in ker phi† satisfy (u/v)^{q^{m-k}}=u/v, so the kernel is one-dimensional over K or zero. A K-linear image meets a K-line only in 0 or that line; F_q hull dimension is 0 or d. This algebra handles all m>=2,1<=k<m, all projective parameters; viewed binary finite enumerator is a stress test only.
